  name: standard-rag-pipeline
  root: root

root:

          file_types: "{{ .vars.file_types }}"
          read_mode: files
        save:
          source_file_ids: ".file_ids"

    - work_item:

        input:

        name: split_chunks
        id: moi:parser.split.documents.length

          chunk_size: "{{ .vars.chunk_size }}"
          overlap: "{{ .vars.overlap }}"
        save:
          chunked_documents: ".documents"

    - work_item:
        name: build_index

          documents: "{{ .state.chunked_documents }}"

          enable_multilevel_index: "{{ .vars.enable_multilevel_index }}"
          section_size: "{{ .vars.section_size }}"

    - work_item:
        name: write_parsed_docset
        id: moi:files.write_documents
        version: v3
        input:
          documents: "{{ .state.parsed_documents }}"

          output_file_id: ".file_id"

          source_asset_ids: ".source_asset_ids"

          parsed_asset_id: ".parsed_asset_id"

          image_distance_metric: "{{ .state.image_index_result.distance_metric }}"
          source: standard-rag-image-index-pipeline
        save:
          image_source_asset_ids: ".source_asset_ids"
          image_vector_asset_id: ".image_vector_asset_id"
